en.hubeali:
And by this chain, said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘Isa<sup>as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup>, may peace be upon our Prophet<sup>as</sup>, said: ‘Woe be unto the evil scholars, how the Fire would be engulfing them!’’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Jesus son of Mary (s.a.) said, ‘Woe to bad scholars! If only they knew how raging fire will engulf them.’”
